rationale: Abstract studies fine-tuning/quantization effects on model safety and guardrail resistance to jailbreaks; no separate binary input prompt-injection detector evaluation is identified.
Title and abstract identify a comprehensive generative-AI cybersecurity review, outside the original empirical detector-paper domain.

Abstract describes a linear task-drift classifier using activations around external-data processing and prompt-injection evaluation. It does not explicitly establish an English-text evaluation setting or pre-answer application of the detector; these domain requirements need human metadata/method evidence.
